instruction: Cinematic full shot of a boxing training session inside a gym ring. On the left, the woman in the black and orange sports top (R1), wearing black leggings and white sneakers, stands holding a red focus mitt. On the right, the Asian woman in the white sports bra (R2), wearing black leggings with sheer panels and beige sneakers, throws a punch with her black boxing glove. The trainer (R1) stands firmly to absorb the blow, while the boxer (R2) lunges forward with athletic focus. The background features red ring ropes and hanging punching bags under cool, dim gym lighting.
elements: R1 holds the red focus mitt that absorbs R2's punch
R2 throws the punch toward R1's mitt while R1 absorbs it
R1 is the trainer standing firmly and R2 is the boxer lunging forward
gym ring with red ropes and hanging punching bags
